text:
maria: Quick shout — Ashley closed on a new house AND got promoted to Staff SWE this week!! :house_with_garden: :tada:
adevin: WHAT. two huge wins. we need snacks and a proper cheer.
leo: I volunteer cake and candles. also confetti (office-safe). :confetti_ball:
ashley: you all are too sweet omg f60a trying not to cry. would love a small lunchtime thing.
maria: poll: :cake: for midday celebration or :sparkles: small after-work gathering with drinks? react to vote.
devin: :cake: from me. daytime so the new homeowner can bounce if they have movers.
leo: :cake: too. can we get a dairy-free option? ashley has a nut preference but not allergies.
ashley: not allergic, just prefer to avoid walnuts. dairy-free is fine but not necessary. thanks for asking!
people-ops-bot: Promo and home celebration logged. $200 celebratory budget approved. Please add charity donation if desired.
maria: idea: cupcakes + a tiny houseplant as a housewarming gift. cheap and easy to carry.
devin: i can pick up cupcakes at 11:30. who wants to sign a card?
ashley: you don't have to get anything huge. a card would mean a lot.
leo: I'll make a quick Spotify playlist 3b5 and bring candles.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Ashley 0b1 House + Promo Mini-Cheer" Thu 12:00-12:20 Kitchen Island. Invite sent. Zoom attached for remote folks.
people-ops-bot: Physical card request submitted. Swag credit available; organizer to confirm allocation.
maria: remote folks, please post short videos if you want them played at the table.
ashley: thank you all so much. can't wait to celebrate with you 60a
leo (reaction): :tada: (added by leo)
devin (reaction): :house_with_garden: (added by devin)
